old_caption: The video captures a port scene at dusk, showcasing large cranes and colorful shipping containers. The sky remains a deep blue, with subtle shifts in hue and cloud texture. The cranes, illuminated by artificial lights, stand tall and imposing. Rows of brightly colored shipping containers line the dock, reflecting the lights. The water in the foreground is calm, mirroring the lights. A chain-link fence runs along the edge of the dock, partially obscuring the view but allowing glimpses of graffiti on the wall behind it. The overall atmosphere is one of industrious activity under the soft light of evening.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a bustling port scene at dusk, showcasing a series of large cranes and colorful shipping containers. The sky transitions from a deep blue to a lighter hue as the sun sets, casting a serene glow over the industrial landscape. The cranes, illuminated by artificial lights, stand tall and imposing, their structures detailed against the twilight backdrop. Rows of brightly colored shipping containers, stacked neatly, line the dock, reflecting the lights and adding vibrancy to the scene. The water in the foreground is calm, mirroring the lights and creating a tranquil reflection. A chain-link fence runs along the edge of the dock, partially obscuring the view but allowing glimpses of graffiti on the wall behind it. The overall atmosphere is one of industrious activity under the soft light of evening.
caption: The video captures a container port at twilight, viewed across a calm stretch of water. A large ship-to-shore crane dominates the center of the frame, its long boom raised diagonally toward the upper left and held idle throughout the excerpt. To the left, a second crane and a container-laden ship sit at the quay's edge, while rows of multicolored shipping containers line the dock beneath a scatter of bright floodlights and a tall pole light on the right. The deep blue sky carries a faint purple band near the horizon. In the foreground, a low concrete wall tagged with graffiti borders the water, where vertical reflections of the lights stretch downward. Across the clip the structures and lights hold their positions, and the only perceptible movement is a soft shimmer in the water's reflections and a gentle flicker around the floodlight halos.
